title: Idiomatic Rule Pack
description: A rule pack is a collection of rules that share metadata and a release lifecycle. Each rule names a capability and supplies the inputs that capability declares. Rule packs are the unit of standards enforcement.

apiVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped only on structural breaks.

pack.title: Pack metadata
pack.description: Identity and release metadata for the pack as a whole.

id.description: Unique identifier within the registry. Lowercase, hyphenated, alphanumeric. Permanent once published — never rename.

version.description: Semver version of this pack release. Bump on every change.

maintainer.description: Who maintains this pack (org, team, or individual).

tags.description: Free-form key-value metadata for discoverability. Conventional keys: language, category, vendor, architecture.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: One rule in a pack. Names the capability that runs it, supplies the per-rule inputs, declares severity, file globs, and fix guidance.

id.description: Unique within the pack. Lowercase, hyphenated, alphanumeric. Permanent once published.

description.description: What the rule checks. One or two sentences.

rationale.description: Why this rule exists — the reasoning a senior engineer would give.

severity.description: error = must fix; warning = should fix; info = awareness.

applies_to.description: File glob patterns this rule checks. Non-empty.

detector.title: Detector
detector.description: Routes the rule to a capability and supplies its inputs.

capability.description: Name of a loaded capability (the capability spec's metadata.name).

version.description: Optional semver constraint on the capability's metadata.version. Empty matches anything. Authors are encouraged to pin to a major version (e.g. '^1') so a future major bump cannot silently change rule behavior. Accepted forms are everything Masterminds/semver/v3 supports: exact (1.0.0), caret (^1, ^1.2), tilde (~1.2), range (>=1.2,<2), wildcard (1.x).

config.description: Per-rule inputs. The shape is defined by the named capability's spec.inputs schema. Validation happens at registry load time using the loaded capability's contract.

test.title: Inline test
test.description: A test fixture that asserts the rule fires (or doesn't) against a code snippet.

should.description: fire = expect a finding; pass = expect no finding.

code.description: Code snippet to run the rule against.
